name: NFDI4DataScience
description: NFDI4DataScience (NFDI4DS) is the National Research Data Infrastructure consortium for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence in Germany (DFG project 460234259). The vision is to support all steps of the interdisciplinary research data lifecycle—collecting and creating, processing, analysing, publishing, archiving, and reusing resources such as publications, data, models, and software code—with the goal of increasing transparency, reproducibility, and fairness. At ZB MED, the Semantic Technologies team contributes to building infrastructures for providing and searching data, software, and data analysis models used in AI research, and develops FAIR metadata solutions including RO-Crate, Bioschemas, machine-actionable software management plans, and ML model registries within the consortium.
